messages:
Ana: Hey team — ChannelWave wants a short co-sell pilot next week. They asked for a joint architecture doc, SSO options, and a pilot pricing proposal. Can SE + Security + Ops help coordinate? @Lee @James :wave:

Lee: I can own the arch one-pager. Quick clarifying Q: do we recommend shared model pool (cheaper) or per-customer VPC for channel pilots?

James: Need cost estimate too. They said ~200 concurrent users, ~150 tokens/rpc average, with short spikes up to 400 rps. Also curious about burst capacity options for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Maya: They'll send a security questionnaire. Any regulated data? PCI/PHI? If not, that's simpler. Also, SAML + audit logs = typical ask.

Ana: No PCI/PHI. Core asks: SSO (SAML ok), audit logs export, tenant isolation guidance. Pricing ask: 3-month pilot with a discount — what's reasonable for co-sell pilots?

Lee: For topology, I usually propose shared model pool + tenant-scoped KV namespaces for pilots — balances cost and isolation. Sketch below:

```
Client -> ChannelWave FE -> Redwood API (hosted)
  routing: partner-policy -> prefer-devoted-pool-or-shared-fallback
  model: quantized-v1 (fallback: quantized-v0)
KV cache: per-tenant namespaces, prefix-caching enabled
Telemetry: per-tenant metrics + aggregated usage
```

Lee: Will draft one-pager diagram and a short runbook for model fallback during spikes.

James: Pricing: for pilots we typically do ~25-35% off hosted list + waived onboarding for 90 days. Offer reserved-capacity credits if they convert. For Dedicated proofs, provide a committed monthly rate with a small trial uplift.

Maya: I'll prepare the security pack (answers + exemplar configs). Question: do we mandate MFA for admin UI for partner-facing pilots? We recommend it strongly.

Ana: ChannelWave prefers Wed 10am PT for a joint tech sync. Also want a short ops playbook for run-of-show and escalation.

Lee: Wed 10am PT works. Runbook snippet for canary + fallback below:

```
rollout:
  canary: 10% of traffic
  monitor: latency_p95, token_cost_per_minute, error_rate
  rollback_if: error_rate > 1% OR latency_p95 > 2s
fallback_policy:
  - switch-to-lower-cap: quantized-v0
  - enable-strict-prefix-caching
```

Lee: Will also add an S3 export example for audit events to feed their SIEM.

James: I'll draft the SOW and pricing sheet. Ana, can you share the partner contact details here?

Ana: Shared DM — adding them to this thread now.

ChannelWave_Steve: Thanks — confirmed Wed 10am PT. Quick Q: expected SLA for pilot? Also want 90-day log retention options.

Maya: For hosted pilot, propose 99% uptime SLA (pilot). For Dedicated we can offer 99.9% with an SLA contract. Default logs retention 30 days; we can extend to 90 days as an enterprise option.

ChannelWave_Rui: SAML is fine. For audit logs, can we stream events to our SIEM (near real-time) or do daily exports work?

Lee: We support event export to S3 (object per day) and a streaming integration for enterprise customers. I'll note both options in the doc.

Ana: Action items: Lee — arch one-pager + runbook + S3/streaming export samples. James — pilot SOW + pricing. Maya — security questionnaire + SAML checklist. I'll send calendar invite and attach docs when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Created project cw-pilot-2026 in infra for tracking — resource group and initial llama pool provisioned.

Ana: Great — closing this thread once docs uploaded.
